info.name: Expense Management API
info.description:
Walks the whole workflow: login, submit, validation rules, manager approval/rejection, dashboard and security.

Start the backend first (http://localhost:8111), then run the folders in order with the Collection Runner. The run is repeatable.

item.name: My expenses contain the new one

exec: pm.test("Contains the new expense", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(e => e.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("expenseId"))).to.be.true);
pm.test("Only my own expenses", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().every(e => e.employeeUsername === "aarav.sharma")).to.be.true);

item.name: Another employee does not see it

exec: pm.test("Not in the other employee's list", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(e => e.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("expenseId"))).to.be.false);
pm.test("Includes the new expense", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(e => e.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("expenseId"))).to.be.true);
pm.test("Cannot be processed again", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("cannot be processed again"));
